sources.title: 欣銓 卡位AI測試商機
sources.locator: Article text describing Ardentec as one of Taiwan's top three IC testing companies.
sources.note: Does not state the ranking basis, denominator, or measurement period.

sources.title: [TW] 3264 欣銓 – 歷年法說會
sources.locator: Section 4, product-application classification and discussion of MCU testing share.
sources.note: Informal historical notes say Taiwan MCU testing share was highest, but provide no percentage and do not establish an 80% share for automotive MCU testing.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.
已達本次研究工具呼叫上限；未找到可驗證車用 MCU 測試市占率 80% 以上的可靠來源，該原子主張維持 UNKNOWN。
經濟部官方資料確認欣銓提供半導體測試工程開發與量產測試服務，但未提供排名或車用 MCU 測試市占率。
「台灣前三大」的媒體表述未揭示排名方法、比較範圍或期間。
